the AudioContext runs
the Air Boss calls flight quarters on the 5MC when the war starts
gunner: clear right
crew chief (left door): taking fire, nine o'clock, priority 3
a Marine out from the board
a Marine calls the contact: direction and range, open air, from where he stands
a casualty call: corpsman / doc / man down
in the Hornet
the ball call: side number, Hornet ball, fuel
LSO: wave off, priority 3 on the recovery freq
pause: the voice stops and the queue clears

expects.expr: __voices.V.log.some(e => e.key === 'pause-test' && e.state === 'paused' && e.end !== null && e.source === null)
expects.label: the cut line is logged as paused and its source stopped
the pause menu has VOICES: ON / RADIO ONLY / OFF
speech produced samples on the isolated voice bus
no two utterances overlapped
wall intersection, rotated wall, above-wall clearance and open doorway
rendered radio PCM passes voice band and rejects bass / high frequencies
effects duck without lowering the voice bus
urgent wave-off interrupts and stops the previous audio source
person keeps a stable voice across roles; crew members have distinct voices
open-air speech fades as listener moves away
wall muffling changes the live speech low-pass
moving out of range stops the actual open-air voice
radio-only mode rejects open-air calls
zero voice volume creates no speech, hiss or squelch
OFF immediately silences speech and radio tails and restores effects gain
bounded priority queue expires stale calls, skips delayed chatter and rejects another crew
no installed system voices: silent subtitles, no native speech call, no radio noise, no errors
